The element counts (15 buses, 15 lines, 18 loads, 13 sgen, 2 storage, 2 transformers, 1 external grid) match `pandapower.networks.create_cigre_network_mv(with_der="all")`, except for the switches (32 in Sherlock, 8 in pandapower). Sherlock's transformers also have tap positions, which the pandapower model lacks. T7 tests whether that pandapower model reproduces the recorded physics.

**G1 (usable grid model in the download): NO.** No pandapower net or Wattson grid definition is included. A candidate reconstruction from pandapower's CIGRE MV (all DER) is evaluated in `sherlock_model_check.md`.
